The '''Czerka Adventurer''' was an accurate long-[[Barrel/Legends|barreled]] [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] [[Slugthrower rifle/Legends|rifle]]. Manufactured by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]], it was somewhat more advanced than the Czerka [[6-2Aug2 hunting rifle/Legends|6-2Aug2 hunting rifle]] as it included an oxidizer release module which increased the bullet's velocity.<ref name="New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

The Adventurer was often used by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] as it was easily assembled and disassembled, allowing it to be smuggled. Additionally, since the weapon fired [[Slug/Legends|slugs]] it was suitable for stealthy night missions as it avoided the bright [[Blaster bolts|bolt]]s of a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] was known to use this weapon.<ref name="New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology" />
